```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const zone = tencentcloud.redis.getZoneConfig({
    typeId: 7,
});
const vpc = new tencentcloud.vpc.Instance("vpc", {
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
    name: "tf_redis_vpc",
});
const subnet = new tencentcloud.subnet.Instance("subnet", {
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    availabilityZone: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[0]?.zone),
    name: "tf_redis_subnet",
    cidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24",
});
const example = new tencentcloud.redis.Instance("example", {
    availabilityZone: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[0]?.zone),
    typeId: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[0]?.typeId),
    password: "Password@123",
    memSize: 8192,
    redisShardNum: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[0]?.redisShardNums?.[0]),
    redisReplicasNum: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[0]?.redisReplicasNums?.[0]),
    name: "tf_example",
    port: 6379,
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    subnetId: subnet.id,
});
const exampleInstancePasswordPolicyConfig = new tencentcloud.redis.InstancePasswordPolicyConfig("example", {
    instanceId: example.id,
    enabled: true,
    minLetterCount: 1,
    minDigitCount: 1,
    minSpecialCount: 1,
    minLength: 8,
});
```

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/redis"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/subnet"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/vpc"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		zone, err := redis.GetZoneConfig(ctx, &redis.GetZoneConfigArgs{
			TypeId: pulumi.IntRef(7),
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		vpc2, err := vpc.NewInstance(ctx, "vpc", &vpc.InstanceArgs{
			CidrBlock: pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),
			Name:      pulumi.String("tf_redis_vpc"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		subnet2, err := subnet.NewInstance(ctx, "subnet", &subnet.InstanceArgs{
			VpcId:            vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			AvailabilityZone: pulumi.String(zone.Lists[0].Zone),
			Name:             pulumi.String("tf_redis_subnet"),
			CidrBlock:        pulumi.String("10.0.1.0/24"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		example, err := redis.NewInstance(ctx, "example", &redis.InstanceArgs{
			AvailabilityZone: pulumi.String(zone.Lists[0].Zone),
			TypeId:           pulumi.Int(zone.Lists[0].TypeId),
			Password:         pulumi.String("Password@123"),
			MemSize:          pulumi.Int(8192),
			RedisShardNum:    pulumi.Int(zone.Lists[0].RedisShardNums[0]),
			RedisReplicasNum: pulumi.Int(zone.Lists[0].RedisReplicasNums[0]),
			Name:             pulumi.String("tf_example"),
			Port:             pulumi.Int(6379),
			VpcId:            vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			SubnetId:         subnet2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = redis.NewInstancePasswordPolicyConfig(ctx, "example", &redis.InstancePasswordPolicyConfigArgs{
			InstanceId:      example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Enabled:         pulumi.Bool(true),
			MinLetterCount:  pulumi.Int(1),
			MinDigitCount:   pulumi.Int(1),
			MinSpecialCount: pulumi.Int(1),
			MinLength:       pulumi.Int(8),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```

```java
package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.RedisFunctions;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.inputs.GetZoneConfigArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.InstancePasswordPolicyConfig;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.InstancePasswordPolicyConfigArgs;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        final var zone = RedisFunctions.getZoneConfig(GetZoneConfigArgs.builder()
            .typeId(7)
            .build());

        var vpc = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Instance("vpc", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .name("tf_redis_vpc")
            .build());

        var subnet = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.Instance("subnet", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .availabilityZone(zone.lists()[0].zone())
            .name("tf_redis_subnet")
            .cidrBlock("10.0.1.0/24")
            .build());

        var example = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.Instance("example", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .availabilityZone(zone.lists()[0].zone())
            .typeId(zone.lists()[0].typeId())
            .password("Password@123")
            .memSize(8192)
            .redisShardNum(zone.lists()[0].redisShardNums()[0])
            .redisReplicasNum(zone.lists()[0].redisReplicasNums()[0])
            .name("tf_example")
            .port(6379)
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .subnetId(subnet.id())
            .build());

        var exampleInstancePasswordPolicyConfig = new InstancePasswordPolicyConfig("exampleInstancePasswordPolicyConfig", InstancePasswordPolicyConfigArgs.builder()
            .instanceId(example.id())
            .enabled(true)
            .minLetterCount(1)
            .minDigitCount(1)
            .minSpecialCount(1)
            .minLength(8)
            .build());

    }
}
```

## Import



redis instance password policy config can be imported using the instance_id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Redis/instancePasswordPolicyConfig:InstancePasswordPolicyConfig example crs-cqdfdzvt
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
